run_video2video_pipeline: run the AnimateDiffVideoToVideoPipeline to transform an input video using a text prompt and strength parameter
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the encode_prompt method with classifier-free guidance
encode_video_latents: encode a video into latent representations using the encode_video method with VAE and chunked processing
prepare_latents_for_denoising: prepare initial latents from a video by encoding, scaling, and adding noise at a given timestep
decode_latents_to_video: decode latent tensors back into video frames using the decode_latents method with chunked VAE decoding
